collectionMethod: 在已授權的真實 Chrome (chrome-devtools MCP) 中開啟 OMEGA 美國官網 /en-us，確認 html lang=en-US、hreflang alternate 指向 https://www.omegawatches.com/en-us/，且商品卡 tracking data-product-dl 標示 website.country=US、website.language=EN、currency=USD 後，於同一 en-us session 以同源請求讀取 16 個官方分類目錄頁（含 ?p=N 分頁）與 548 筆官方商品詳情頁；面盤說明取自詳情頁 technical-data 的 watch_dial 或 watch_dial_detailed_color，兩者皆不存在時保留官方 description 原文。
referenceSource: 官方商品卡 span.tracking-data 的 data-sku（含點分隔的完整官方參考號），並於抽查時以商品詳情頁 technical-data data-code="sku" 交叉確認。
priceSource: 官方商品卡 span.price 顯示文字與同一卡片的 data-price-amount，並以 data-product-dl 的 ecommerce.items[0].price 三方比對。

productDetail.dialDescription: A timeless collection since 1994, the OMEGA De Ville Prestige is now in its third generation. Continuing to represent classical design and refined elegance, the timepieces offer a range of patterns, finishes and colours to suit different lifestyles and personalities. In this 40 mm stainless steel - 18K Sedna™ Gold model, the domed silvery dial features a crystal finish. The display is distinguished by PVD Sedna™ Gold coloured hands, as well as alternating Roman numerals and cabochon indexes. The pure look of the timepiece is completed by a date window at 6 o’clock, and a railway minute track on the outer zone. This Master Chronometer certified watch is presented on a brown leather strap and is driven by the OMEGA Master Co-Axial Calibre 8800, which can be admired through the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal caseback.
